verdicts.reason: All rules hold: a program checks each kept line for a verbatim transcript quote with a turn or line locator (A1); status assisted matches the brief (A2); it cuts unmatched lines, which blocks imported history (A3); kept 0 / cut N is a valid result (A4); and checkRunnable false is honest because the line-trace checker is absent (A5).

All rules hold: a program state-diff allows only an empty signature block and fails any added assessment, plan, signature or attestation (A1, A3); status gated stays within the brief's Stop rating (A2); presenting the unchanged note is the valid result (A4); and checkRunnable false is honest (A5).

All rules hold: a program checks each non-MISSING field as a verbatim transcript substring with a locator (A1); status assisted does not exceed the brief's 'Assisted to reliable' (A2); unstated fields must read MISSING, so gaps are not smoothed (A3); all-MISSING is valid (A4); and checkRunnable false is honest because the line-trace checker is absent (A5).

All rules hold: a program lists and counts the empty fields and checks that the ask matches that list by set equality (A1); status assisted matches the brief (A2); it names exactly the empty fields with no proposed value (A3); 'gaps: 0' is valid (A4); and checkRunnable false is honest because no template validator is registered (A5).
